description_en: Queries the list of data destinations associated with a specified parser
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定解析器关联的数据目的列表
name: ListParserDestination

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the data destination to query is configured for forwarding error data, which is data that failed to be forwarded to other cloud services and also failed after retries.

true: The data destination is for forwarding error data.
false (default): The data destination is not for forwarding error data, but for normal forwarding operations
parameters.help_zh:
待查询数据目的配置是否为转发错误操作数据，即转发流转到其他云产品失败且重试失败的数据。

true：是转发错误操作数据。
false（默认）：不是转发错误操作数据，而是正常转发操作
parameters.name: is_failover

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this ID value exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html

IsFailover.description_en:
Indicates whether the data destination is configured for forwarding error data, which is data that failed to be forwarded to other cloud services and also failed after retries.

true: The data destination is for forwarding error data.
false (default): The data destination is not for forwarding error data, but for normal forwarding operations
IsFailover.description_zh:
该数据目的配置是否为转发错误操作数据，即转发流转到其他云产品失败且重试失败的数据。

Name.description_en: The name of the data destination

Type.description_en:
The operation type of the data destination.

REPUBLISH: Forwards the topic data processed by the data parsing script to another communication topic on IoT Platform.
AMQP: Forwards the topic data processed by the data parsing script to an AMQP consumer group through data forwarding.
DATAHUB: Forwards the topic data processed by the data parsing script to Alibaba Cloud DataHub for stream data processing.
ONS: Forwards the topic data processed by the data parsing script to ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ for message distribution.
MNS: Sends the topic data processed by the data parsing script to Alibaba Cloud Message Service for message transmission.
FC: Sends the topic data processed by the data parsing script to Alibaba Cloud Function Compute service for event computing.
OTS: Sends the topic data processed by the data parsing script to Alibaba Cloud Tablestore for NoSQL data storage
Type.description_zh:
数据目的的操作类型。

REPUBLISH：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据转发至物联网平台的另一个通信Topic。
AMQP：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据流转到AMQP消费组。
DATAHUB：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据转发至阿里云DataHub，进行流式数据处理。
ONS：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据转发至阿里云消息队列RocketMQ，进行消息分发。
MNS：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据发送至阿里云消息服务中，进行消息传输。
FC：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据发送至阿里云函数计算服务，进行事件计算。
OTS：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据发送至阿里云表格存储（Tablestore），进行NoSQL数据存储
